PowerShell(git commit -m "Tide Run: stop deleting visible current zones mid-frame" -m "spawnHazard's lookahead loop placed currents 1 canvas-width ahead of the boat, then a later iteration of the same loop could pick 'shoal' and run the current-overlap sweep - which deleted any current within ~32% of cw of the new shoal, including foam patches the player was already steering around. The sweep now skips currents whose left edge has already entered the viewport; the narrow-shoal fallback \(currentBeforeShoal\) still keeps the encounter fair." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

PowerShell(git commit -m "Raids: chapter collapsible the moment the main path is cleared" -m "Previously the chevron only appeared when the chapter was FULLY cleared \(main + every available side branch\). Players now want to be able to close a chapter as soon as the boss is down even if optional challenge raids are still hanging - the header still advertises the remaining count, so the challenges aren't lost from view. Default state is unchanged \(fully cleared = collapsed; main-cleared-with-challenges = expanded\); the change is just that the toggle now works in both directions." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

PowerShell(git commit -m "Marketplace: drop the mini-tag pills, keep cards uniformly sized" -m "Stripped the tags={[...]} prop from every DestCard call \(Fish Market, Tackle Shop, Shipyard, Membership, Seas the Booty\) and removed the Tag helper + tag-rendering blocks from DestCard. Compact cards still pin minHeight: 220 so the 2-col grid rows equalize cleanly; Fish Market is the full-width default-variant card and is intentionally taller." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

PowerShell(git commit -m "Shipyard: surface raid item slot count on every ship card" -m "raidItemSlotsForTier is already a tuned tier ladder \(T0/1=1, T2/3=2, T4=3, T5/6=4\) and it's a meaningful upgrade pull - T2, T4, T5 each unlock another raid item slot. Previously only visible inside the loadout drawer in ShipHero. Now it sits in the active-ship hero \(5th HeroStat, violet accent\) and on every fleet card \(5th StatChip\), so a player eyeing T5 sees they would get a 4th item slot before they buy." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

PowerShell(git commit -m "Verdigris Hull: drop the neon hue-rotate, use Corsair Black's filter with green glow" -m "Old filter \(brightness 0.46 / saturate 1.4 / hue-rotate 95deg / contrast 1.18\) was reading as garish neon green because hue-rotate shifts every pixel's hue including the highlights and decking, producing colors the original art never had. With saturation cranked to 1.4 on top, the result fought every ship tier's base palette." -m "New filter mirrors Corsair Black exactly \(brightness 0.5 / saturate 0.2 / contrast 1.1\) so the hull reads as a clean dark silhouette across all tiers, with the verdigris identity carried by the drop-shadow alone - rgba\(60,165,110,0.35\), a muted copper-patina green. Chip color bumped to #43a884 so the equip badge reads as the skin's theme instead of a near-black sliver." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

PowerShell(git commit -m "Tide Run: drop 'of N' from the wreck-screen rank line" -m "Just 'You're #5' now. Rank alone is still actionable; the gap line below carries the motivator. \(totalPlayers stays in the action payload in case we want to re-surface it elsewhere.\)" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")

PowerShell(git commit -m "Raids: Krust Overseer speed 9 \\xe2\\x86\\x92 6 \(no longer fastest in the run\)" -m "Overseer was tuned as the elite cadence-pressure test with shipSpeed 9. After the turn-order rework \(d20 \\xe2\\x86\\x92 d30, Compass 0.25 \\xe2\\x86\\x92 0.20\) that lean is too sharp \\xe2\\x80\\x94 the Overseer was outpacing nearly every player build at the new die. Drops to 6 \(parity with Pete\) so the encounter still tests rotation management + Carapace soak, just without the first-strike denial layered on top." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>")
